trials.claim: Tool provides AI-based SEO and web analysis in one dashboard
trials.claimQuote: Analyze and monitor your website in one dashboard with an AI-based SEO and web analysis tool
trials.reasoning: The vendor describes AI-assisted SEO workflows, audits, crawling, rank tracking, and reporting in one workspace, and a buyer confirms a clean, easy-to-understand dashboard. The missing AI Search Visibility feature limits one advertised capability but does not contradict the broader AI-based SEO and web analysis dashboard.

exhibits.quote: AI Search Visibility is advertised but isn't available yet (the team confirmed it's on the roadmap).
exhibits.argument: The advertised AI visibility capability did not actually exist at time of review.

exhibits.quote: We may update, improve, remove, or limit features as the product evolves.
exhibits.argument: The vendor reserves the right to remove or limit features, so dashboard coverage is not guaranteed.

exhibits.quote: Screpy combines AI-assisted SEO workflows with technical audits, website crawling, keyword rank tracking, Core Web Vitals, and SEO reporting in one workspace.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states its product combines AI-assisted SEO workflows and audits in one workspace.

exhibits.quote: What I love most about Screpy is its simplicity, ease-of-use, and its clean and easy to understand dashboard.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms the tool provides a clean and easy dashboard for website monitoring.
